title: Bug triage: frontend does not load
prompt:
[URGENT BUG] The co-founder reports the game does not run at all. VERIFY IT YOURSELF FIRST: read_repo_file('src/game.js') and look at the very FIRST and LAST lines of the file. They contain a Python triple-quote (three double-quote characters) wrapping the whole JavaScript file, which makes the browser fail to parse it — the page renders nothing. The 116 lines between them are valid.

Do all of this now:
1. file_a bug issue with create_github_issue (labels 'bug') titled 'game.js wrapped in Python triple quotes - frontend fails to parse', with reproduction and expected vs actual.
2. Ask startup-ui-dev via your agent tool to fix it: rewrite src/game.js with write_repo_file containing ONLY the JavaScript, with no triple quotes and no markdown code fences on the first or last line.
3. Re-read the file and confirm the first line now starts with 'const canvas' and the last line is real JavaScript. Only then move the bug card to done.
4. Write a lesson to docs/learning/qa-engineer.md: source files must be verified to parse, and cards must never be closed on unverified code — three cards were closed on this broken file.
